breaking.change: An aligned follower now faces along the path as every object does: its +Z along the tangent. It used to be turned as a camera, -Z along the tangent, so a model travelled backwards. `offset` is unchanged (the path's right, up and backwards).
breaking.fix: Remove any half-turn a game added to its model or its children to face it along the path. For a camera riding a path, sample the path and set og.transform.lookAt(position, position + tangent).
